canonical_project: TNPDCL Tirunelveli Regional Data Centre for LT Billing / Project BEST
owner: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Limited (TNPDCL, formerly TANGEDCO)
notes: Official TNPDCL tender specification for Tirunelveli Region describes maintenance of servers, SAN, network equipment, UPS, LAN, backup/reporting, 24x7 manpower and VPN links for the Regional Data Centre supporting LT Billing / Project BEST. This is a utility regional data centre, not a disclosed commercial hyperscale facility.
